newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Everbright signs US$1.05 bln loan.
newsitem.headline: China Everbright signs US$1.05 bln loan.

text.p: China Everbright Holdings Co Ltd said on Wednesday that one of its units had signed a US$1.05 billion 12-month loan to part-finance its purchase of 7.74 percent of Hong Kong Telecommunications Ltd.
The borrowing by Everbright Finance and Investment Co Ltd (EFIC), a 100 percent arm of China Everbright, was guaranteed by its parent, China Everbright said in a statement.
"The closing of the (Hongkong Telecom) transaction will occur on or before June 6, and the funding of the loan facility will occur contemporaneously," it said.
The Hongkong Telecom shares would be used as security for the facility, it said.

China Everbright last month announced it was paying CITIC Pacific Ltd HK$11.4 billion for the Hongkong Telecom stake, ending months of speculation about CITIC Pacific's plans for its Hongkong Telecom stake.
It said the loan arrangers would start general syndication of the facility, which it expected to close by June 19.

The arrangers are: China Construction Bank Hong Kong branch, China International Capital Corp, China Development Finance Co (HK), HSBC Investment Bank Asia, Goldman Sachs (Asia) Finance and Hang Seng Finance.
